float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Both accumulate the phase in float32 wrapped to [-pi, pi) and take cos/sin: they differ by float32 rounding of the accumulated phase (ulp of pi is 2.4e-7) and of the sine evaluation, a random walk over 2048 samples (measured 6e-6).

fixed_vs_float.rationale: The 32-bit phase accumulator makes the increment error negligible; the 1024 entry table rounds the phase to the nearest entry: phase error at most pi/1024 = 3.1e-3 rad, i.e. 3.1e-3 per component and 4.4e-3 as magnitude, plus amplitude 2^15 - 1 and rounding 2^-15.
As above with a 4096 entry table: phase error at most pi/4096 = 7.7e-4 rad, 1.1e-3 as magnitude.
